playbook.intent: A model has produced two dozen plausible-looking user stories and someone is one click away from pasting them into the backlog. The pass is over when each story has been kept, rewritten or thrown out on a stated ground, and every survivor can be traced to a real need that a named person in the business will vouch for.
playbook.scope: Run any AI-generated batch of user stories through a structured truth check before they touch the backlog. One batch in, validated subset out.

success-criteria.criterion: Every story in the batch carries an explicit verdict — keep, rewrite, discard — with the reason recorded beside it
Each surviving story names a user role that exists in the product today, not a persona the generator invented to fill out the template
Stories describing behaviour the system already ships, or duplicating each other under different wording, were collapsed or dropped before anything reached the backlog
Each survivor links to the request, interview or ticket it answers, so a reader can check the claim without trusting the generator
The discard pile is kept with its reasons, so the same invented story is not regenerated and re-argued next month

stage.name: Prep
stage.intent: Get inputs, environment, and prior context lined up before the session starts.

tasks.task: Read the assigned methodology references and reconcile them with this stage's goal.
Produce the stage artifact named in 'outputs' and store it where the next stage can read it.
Re-check the decision gate before advancing; loop within this stage if it fails.

stage.decision-gate: Advance when the stage 1 artifact exists in writing AND the methodology chain assigned to this stage has been applied. Iterate or escalate otherwise.
